Qarafaay, An-Nahri kee Tashriq ayroora tabluh hijrih ayro culus
Gitat tan Hijrih ayro culus. Liggidi 1300 ilaa 1600 fan, alsi 1 ilaa 12 fan, ayro 1 ilaa 30 fan.

Faxe Hijriyah ayro culus (hinnay awayih ayro dacrisaanam) sissikuk Cajjih ayro isi sanat geytuh: Qarafah ayro (9 Zul-Hijjah), An-Nahr Ayro (10 Zul-Hijjah) kee Tashreeq Ayro (11, 12 kee 13 Zul-Hijjah) lih. ku ayrot ramad le arac.
Kaxxa qamiddu: Arafah ayro carraak lakal ayro cultam fan soolaanam, mango xaaqo abaanam, takbir kee tahlil abaanam. Nabiyyi (SAW) iyyem: "Hajj Qarafah."
Qiid Al-Adha: Jamarat Al-Aqabah 7 xaahi xaahi xaahi xaahi xagar, fida kah xayyoosan innah, moolan hinnay trim, tohuk lakal Tawaf al-Ifadah kee Sai.
Cajji ayroorah addat (8-13 Zul-Hijjah) uddur yucsuben siirat koo kassisah yan ayroh maysaxxaga.

Ta ayroh sunna: ihram culak, Mina fanah gexak, bar elle sugtaah, Talbiyah "Labbayk Allahumma labbayk" axcuk qagaaqagitak, salat uxxuk ittat axawah haak, tokkel salat aba.
Sidiica Jamarat carraak lakal: qunxa, tohuk lakal gude, tohuk lakal kaxxa, malcina pebbles kulli num takbir abak, qunxaaneyta kee fanti tiyaak lakal xaaqo abak.
Kimal elle sugtennal carraak lakal sidiica Jamaraat qagaaqagitak xaa haanama. Faxe num yasissikeemi ayro cultaamak naharal Mina cabam duudah; faxe num elle raaqam bar kee xaa sidoc haytoh ayro.
Sidiica Jamarat Carraak Lakal Xayyoosaanam, Tokkeek Makkak Yawqen Wak Tawaaf Fanah Hajj Akah Yaybullen Innah Abaanama. Cajji Yalli oggolaay.

Hajj kee Umra wagsiisak inkih tan maqnisso: maqnisso kee madqooqi, ritmitte qaynatitte, mawaqit, ritmitte step by step sinni qilmi kee kulli stationil maca iyyaanam faxximtam, ihram haram, kee dooqa. Atu kusaaqissam faxxa footima door.
